Repository: sphinx-doc/sphinx
Base commit: a73617c51b9e29d7f059a2794f4574bb80cfcf57
### Issue
autodoc: Load sphinx.ext.autodoc.typehints automatically
After typehints enough matured, it should be loaded automatically from autodoc extension.
refs: #6418 

### Candidate patch
```diff
diff --git a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/__init__.py b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/__init__.py
index 97995a410..697f358cc 100644
--- a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/__init__.py
+++ b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/__init__.py
@@ -1753,5 +1753,5 @@ def setup(app: Sphinx) -> Dict[str, Any]:
     app.add_event('autodoc-skip-member')
 
     app.setup_extension('sphinx.ext.autodoc.type_comment')
-
+    app.setup_extension('sphinx.ext.autodoc.typehints')
     return {'version': sphinx.__display_version__, 'parallel_read_safe': True}

```

parsed.reason: The patch correctly updates the autodoc extension to load the typehints module automatically.
